faq.label: // questions
faq.title: Frequent questions.
faq.q1: How much does a project cost?
faq.a1: Impossible to say without knowing the need: after a free exchange, you receive a written proposal — scope, timeline, price. No generic price list.
faq.a2: A showcase website takes weeks, an application takes months. The timeline is written in the proposal, with regular demos.
faq.a3: You leave with the code and all access. Follow-up remains possible for evolutions and maintenance.
faq.q4: Why work with an early-career developer?
faq.a4: Because you pay for the work, not the overhead: direct exchange, careful code, honest prices — and each project is a reference to earn.
